video_title: SOURCE: Despite report, Kings have not spoken to Hornets regarding potential Domantas Sabonis trade

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings have not held trade talks with Hornets for Domantas Sabonis
quotes.excerpt: There was no conversation between the Kings and the Charlotte Hornets regarding Domantas Sabonis at the trade deadline.
quotes.quote: According to my source, there was no conversation between the Kings and the Charlotte Hornets regarding Domantas Sabonis at the trade deadline. That is, according to my source, not accurate.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings would not trade Domantas Sabonis for a simple salary dump
quotes.excerpt: You're not just going to dump an All-NBA player, a guy who led the league in rebounding.
quotes.quote: The idea that the Kings would trade Domantas Sabonis in a straight salary dump was completely shot down as well. A trade like that would cost at least one first-round pick and possibly two. You're not just going to dump an All-NBA player, a guy who led the league in rebounding, just because.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis and De'Aaron Fox are building blocks for the Kings
quotes.excerpt: When you make an All-NBA team, they are considered top 15, top 20 players in the league.
quotes.quote: When you make an All-NBA team, and the year Domantas Sabonis and De'Aaron Fox both made third team All-NBA, they were literally number 11 and number 12 in voting. That means that they are considered top 11, top 12, top 15, top 20 players in the league. If you've got two of them that are in the top 20, you probably have something that you're building around.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa rumors about refusing to play for Sacramento are false
quotes.excerpt: AJ Dybantsa had no problems meeting with the Sacramento Kings during the season.
quotes.quote: When Kevin O'Connor put out that AJ Dybantsa could pull an Eli Manning and just withdraw from the draft or refuse to go to Sacramento, when you're a big national guy and you put that out, it has weight. AJ Dybantsa had no problems meeting with the Sacramento Kings during the season when the Jazz and Kings played in Utah. There was no ill will there at all, and actually some interest.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings front office intends to move off large veteran contracts
quotes.excerpt: The intent of the Kings front office is to move off one or more of their large contracts.
quotes.quote: The intent of the Kings front office is to move off one or more of their large contracts. As a player, I think Domantas Sabonis out of all of their larger contract players still has the most value. He's got more value than Zach LaVine, he's got more value than DeMar DeRozan, he's got more value than DeAndre Hunter.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings have no interest in bringing back Yuta Watanabe
quotes.excerpt: The Kings had absolutely no interest in bringing back Yuta Watanabe.
quotes.quote: The Kings also, from what I know, they had absolutely no interest in bringing back Yuta Watanabe. I like Yuta Watanabe as a player, but he has four years and 130 million dollars remaining on his contract. The Kings are not looking to, unless it's the absolute perfect player that fits their timeline, they're not going to take back a 30-something million dollar player.

quotes.speaker: James Ham
quotes.summary_phrase: Scott Perry is not interested in a two-timeline roster strategy
quotes.excerpt: Scott Perry is not interested in a two-timeline situation.
quotes.quote: Scott Perry is not interested in a two-timeline situation. He's not trying to do what the Golden State Warriors did and failed miserably at, where you have this young core standing over there and you have this aging core that's sitting over there, and then you're going to ask Doug Christie to somehow blend those two together.
